plugins.name: kcc-core
plugins.description: Core plugin: thinking & communication principles injected at session start, with a subagent variant injected into every spawned subagent.

plugins.name: kcc-dev-core
plugins.description: Development-focused plugin: conditionally injects code-discipline principles when the session is inside a software project (with a subagent variant injected into every spawned subagent), and hosts standalone dev skills (spec, blackbox-tests, unit-tests) and hooks.

plugins.name: kcc-ablation
plugins.description: Prompt-ablation toolkit: the ablate skill runs sealed A/B campaigns that measure what each rule in an injected prompt is worth, with the portable mechanics (arm builder, extractor, run screening, Fisher-exact verdicts, blinded judging) bundled as scripts.

plugins.name: kcc-pm
plugins.description: Business-agnostic senior PM × product-ops capability with zero session-start footprint: a task-scoped playbook skill carrying the role charter (iron laws, evidence discipline, output spec — per-rule A/B ablated on Opus-class arms) and the workflow router, a dispatchable kcc-pm agent that keeps the persona out of the main session entirely, and an interview-driven onboarding command that builds per-project PM context files.

plugins.name: kcc-guard
plugins.description: Enforcement for the kcc install: a PreToolUse hook that refuses edits to kcc-managed files, so the project's own agent cannot drift them. Detection (the lockfile and `--check`) says what changed after the fact; this says no at the moment of the edit — and it holds even under bypassPermissions.
